how_to_apply: Fill the application form only in online mode at the University's Careers Portal, https://careers.amuonline.ac.in, by 21 November 2026 (up to 11:59 P.M.), following the instructions in the advertisement and the User Manual on the portal.
Fill a separate application form for each post listed under a different serial number.
Pay the Rs. 500/- processing fee online at the Careers Portal (PwD candidates exempted as above).
After submitting, take a printout of the PDF of the application form on A-4 size paper.
Sign it and paste a recent front-facing photograph at the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.

Send the form by post, writing on the top-left of the cover the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date, to: Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002.
The hard copy must reach by 30 November 2026; hard copies will not be received after 30.11.2026 (04:00 p.m.), and the University will not be responsible for postal delay.

The Local Selection Committee for eligible candidates will be held on 8 December 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh. Candidates must report with all original documents half an hour before the scheduled time. No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued.

Assistant Professor candidates must bring one presentation on the topic of their area of interest in their concerned subject, in soft copy (pen drive), for presentation at the interview. The University may constitute a committee to scrutinise and short-list applications and reserves the right to restrict the number called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not print separate experience requirements for either post. Other eligibility points printed in the notice: Applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the application form. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum; meeting them does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for interview. Relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. For Madrasa background applicants, a certificate equivalent to High School or Graduation will be considered if obtained from Madaris/Institution recognized by the University, wherever applicable. Only persons with a relevant disability to a minimum extent of 40% may apply for posts earmarked for PwD candidates. They must upload a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I, available on the Careers Portal) issued by the Competent Authority. The Proforma is also available on https://www.amu.ac.in and https://www.amuregistrar.com . Applicable categories: (A) Blindness and low vision (VH); (B) Deaf and hard of hearing (HH); (C) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH); (D) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (E) Multiple disabilities from amongst (A) to (D) including deaf-blindness. The disability claim of the selected applicant will be examined by the Medical Board of the University before the appointment letter is issued. Candidates should check the official notification and the NMC norms/Residency Scheme adopted by AMU for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.text: The hard copy must reach by 30 November 2026; hard copies will not be received after 30.11.2026 (04:00 p.m.), and the University will not be responsible for postal delay. The Local Selection Committee for eligible candidates will be held on 8 December 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh. Candidates must report with all original documents half an hour before the scheduled time. No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued. Assistant Professor candidates must bring one presentation on the topic of their area of interest in their concerned subject, in soft copy (pen drive), for presentation at the interview. The University may constitute a committee to scrutinise and short-list applications and reserves the right to restrict the number called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Enclose attested/self-attested copies with the application form and bring the originals for verification at the interview: All marksheets, certificates and degrees from Class Xth to postgraduation, including the High School Certificate from a recognised Board and the mark-sheets and degrees of Graduation and Post-Graduation Internship completion certificate Valid registration of Graduation and Post graduation from NMC Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc., as the case may be M.Phil/Ph.D. degree, wherever applicable Experience certificates, wherever applicable, and other testimonials No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if employed, and relieving orders of all previous employers Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I), for PwD candidates A candidate who does not bring the originals will not be allowed to appear before the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AMU JNMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Assistant Professor in Microbiology and 1 Senior Resident in the R.G. Centre for Diabetes & Endocrinology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 21 November 2026 (up to 11:59 P.M.), and the hard copy must reach the Dean's office by 30 November 2026 (04:00 p.m.).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Qualifications for both posts are as per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor post carries Pay Level AL-10 and the Senior Resident post carries Pay Level AL-11.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: A non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- per application form is paid online at the Careers Portal; PwD candidates are exempted if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the hard copy be sent?
faq.answer: By post to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002, with the post, advertisement number and date written on the top-left of the cover.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The Local Selection Committee meets on 8 December 2026 in the Office of the Dean: Assistant Professor at 12:30 p.m. (report 12:00 noon) and Senior Resident at 01:00 p.m. (report 12:30 p.m.).

faq.question: Q8. Will an interview letter be sent?
faq.answer: No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued for the Local Selection Committee on 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Do Assistant Professor candidates need to give a presentation?
faq.answer: Yes, they must bring one presentation on their area of interest in their concerned subject, in soft copy on a pen drive.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No, appointments will be on a purely temporary basis, subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.
